This is truly a threat defense strategy.|Inventory Description}} {{QuoteBox|Send out a mecha every couple of seconds to run over and shoot zombies.|Former Inventory Description}} }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Mecha Base''' is currently a [[Towers|tower]] exclusive to anyone who is an administrator or higher in the Tower Defense Simulator Discord server, though on rare occasions it has been given to other people. It is planned to become an evolved version of the [[Military Base]] in the fourth quarter of 2026.{{InlineQuote|Evolved from Military Base. An advanced base that deploys mechs and brings high-impact battlefield abilities.|[https://trello.com/c/8EGpJVaN/30-tower-mecha-base Tower Defense Simulator Roadmap]}} It spawns futuristic units which can attack enemies as it moves. Each vehicle spawns at the end of the path, with regular intervals between each spawn. It heads towards the start of the path until it is destroyed. If it reaches the start of the map, it will naturally be destroyed. The '''Mecha Base''' spawns several mechanized walkers called Marks that upgrade in stats depending on the level of the '''Mecha Base'''. The units can shoot bullets from afar, and upgraded variations can also shoot missiles which deal splash damage. }} ==Strategy== *The '''Mecha Base''' is extremely useful for large maps, like [[Tropical Isles]] and [[Polluted Wasteland II]], due to its units having long range. **It is not as effective on shorter maps like [[Dead Ahead]], but still remains highly impactful due to its high ram damage and relatively low spawnrate. **In maps with multiple paths, only one unit spawns as opposed to two. This unit will go down a random path. *The '''Mecha Base''' can be an effective counter against enemies with defense, such as the [[Warden (Modern Enemy)|Warden]] or [[Fallen Guardian]], as they deal full damage when colliding with enemies. **The missiles can also deal full damage to defense enemies. **The gun is still affected by defense. *The '''Mecha Base''' is particularly powerful against fast and tanky enemies, such as the [[Bloated]] and [[Nimble]] [[Fallen Tank]] you would see in [[Hidden Wave]]. **This is even more effective when considering Mecha Base's slow movement speed on a longer map. *The '''Mecha Base''' is useful against bosses, as it cannot be stunned or have debuffs applied to it. **However, some enemies can deal damage to units with their attacks. For example, the [[Fallen King]] deals 150 damage to units with its ''Sword Swing'' ability. ***This generally should not be a problem, due to the '''Mecha Base's''' units high health at later levels. At max level, mecha base has enough HP to survive two of [[Void Reaver (Legacy)|Void Reaver's]] attacks, which used to destroy any unit tower. *It is best advised to place the tower away from the main path as it has no use close to it. *[[DJ Booth]] and the [[Commander]] cannot increase range or decrease firerate of the any of the units, respectively. **DJ Booth can still provide a substantial discount to upgrades. *The '''Mecha Base''' at max is capable of any defending every kind of detection. *The '''Mecha Base''' is a powerful [[Hacker]] clone candidate. ==Trivia== *During [[Hardcore Testing BETA]], the '''Mecha Base''' was obtainable through the [[Hardcore Lobby]] at the cost of {{Gem|3,500}}. However, when the [[Overhaul v1.0|Overhaul Update]] released, it was no longer obtainable and became exclusive again. **The '''Mecha Base''' was only added to the game as a public tower to test units in the [[Overhaul v1.0|Overhaul Update]]. **This also makes it the first exclusive tower to be publicly used. *The '''Mecha Base''' was originally based on the [[w:c:roblox-tower-battles:Zed|Zed]] from ''Tower Battles''. However, after Hardcore testing, the '''Mecha Base''' significantly deviated from it design wise. *There was a bug where the '''Mecha Base''' did not spawn [[Mark V]]s at Level 5, instead spawning [[Mark IV]]s. **Additionally, the [[Mark IV]] and [[Mark V]] were both mislabeled as [[Mark III]]. ***All of these bugs were fixed in the [[v1.1.0|Entity System Update]]. *The '''Mecha Base''' used to use [[Medic]] upgrade icons, instead of using its own unique ones. **Before the [[Overhaul v1.0|Overhaul Update]], it used [[Military Base]] icons. **It is likely the '''Mecha Base''' used the [[Medic]] upgrade icons as it was the next tower alphabetically. **The upgrade prices were also the same as [[Medic]] upgrade prices, with the exception of base cost. **In addition, the '''Mecha Bases''' upgrade stats during [[Hardcore Testing BETA]] were labelled as "''REMIND TO REMAKE STATS''", hinting that the tower was not fully complete. ***The [[Medic]] also had stats labelled as
